grouping_decision.name: YUNG's Better Mineshafts
grouping_decision.rationale: These are biome, material, decoration and support variants of the same specialized mineshaft network generator. All share BetterMineshaftStructure and BetterMineshaftGenerator. Their structure definitions differ only in biome constraints and BetterMineshaftConfiguration. Rooms, intersections, ore deposits, tunnels and entrance pieces are generated components, not additional families. This decision does not imply that arbitrary structures sharing a generic jigsaw codec belong to one family.
